objective: Merge point-in-time Stock Connect eligibility evidence with accepted FMDL-5E screening data to produce an auditable Hong Kong Stock Connect research-investable universe without mistaking continuity evidence for fresh Current data.

eligibility_source_statuses.FRESH_OFFICIAL: Fresh SSE/SZSE primary evidence was acquired in the current run and all upstream source gates passed.
eligibility_source_statuses.LKG_CONTINUITY: A previously validated official same/near-date snapshot is used only to calculate provisional continuity evidence after current-run source blocking; publication is prohibited.

status_semantics.PASS_CURRENT: All source, eligibility, merge, quality and freshness gates pass; eligible for R2F independent release validation.
status_semantics.BLOCKED_STALE_FMDL5E: Eligibility is fresh, but FMDL-5E research/market factors exceed the freshness contract; provisional universe evidence may be inspected but must not be promoted as Current.
status_semantics.BLOCKED_SOURCE_CONTINUITY: Current-run primary eligibility acquisition failed and LKG continuity evidence was used; provisional universe evidence may be inspected but must not be promoted as Current.
status_semantics.BLOCKED_SOURCE_AND_STALE_FMDL5E: Both current-run eligibility source freshness and FMDL-5E freshness are blocked; provisional intersection is diagnostic only.
status_semantics.BLOCKED_SOURCE_OR_QUALITY: A non-recoverable source, coverage, point-in-time or zero-tolerance quality gate failed.
